messages.author: f685ba683a1d8a43
messages.subject: Error when publishing app to shiny.io
parts:
I have developed a package called "Predict Word", which i have hosted on github. This package has dependencies of below packages,

library(stringi)
library(tm)
library(RWeka)
library(tidyr)

I am able to successfully run , load the package locally. Developed Shiny app to use this package to predict next word based on input given by the user. This app is working absolutely fine when i am working locally.

Issue: I am trying to publish this to shinyapps.io, it is giving below error,

* installing *source* package �PredictWord� ...
** R
** preparing package for lazy loading
Error in library(tm) : there is no package called �tm�
Error : unable to load R code in package �PredictWord�
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package �PredictWord�
* removing �/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/PredictWord�
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 504722987 failed: Error building image: Error building PredictWord (0.1.0). Build exited with non-zero status: 1
Execution halted

Can anybody please  help on this.

Thanks,
Venkata Muttineni
